content:
You plan to visit 6 European cities for 16 days in total. You only take direct flights to commute between cities. You plan to stay in Porto for 5 days. You would like to visit Prague for 4 days. You plan to stay in Reykjavik for 4 days. You are going to attend a wedding in Reykjavik between day 4 and day 7. You want to spend 2 days in Santorini. You would like to visit Amsterdam for 2 days. During day 14 and day 15, you have to attend a conference in Amsterdam. You want to spend 4 days in Munich. You want to meet a friend in Munich between day 7 and day 10.

Here are the cities that have direct flights:
Porto and Amsterdam, Munich and Amsterdam, Reykjavik and Amsterdam, Munich and Porto, Prague and Reykjavik, Reykjavik and Munich, Amsterdam and Santorini, Prague and Amsterdam, Prague and Munich.

Find a trip plan of visiting the cities for 16 days by taking direct flights to commute between them.

Please output the trip plan in the following JSON format:
{"itinerary": [{"day_range": "Day X-Y", "place": "<CITY>"}]}. Include all city visits with their day ranges. Do not include separate flight entries in the JSON output.

IMPORTANT: When you fly from city A to city B on day X, that day counts for BOTH cities. For example:
- If you stay in Venice from Day 1-3 and fly to Vienna on Day 3, then:
  - Venice: Day 1-3 (3 days)
  - Vienna: Day 3-6 (4 days, including the flight day)
- The flight day (Day 3) is counted for both Venice and Vienna.
- Do NOT create separate flight entries in the JSON.

{
  "itinerary": [
    { "day_range": "Day 1-4", "place": "Prague" },
    { "day_range": "Day 4-7", "place": "Reykjavik" },
    { "day_range": "Day 7-10", "place": "Munich" },
    { "day_range": "Day 10-14", "place": "Porto" },
    { "day_range": "Day 14-15", "place": "Amsterdam" },
    { "day_range": "Day 15-16", "place": "Santorini" }
  ]
}
 
/* Explanation:
– We must visit 6 cities (Prague, Reykjavik, Munich, Porto, Amsterdam, Santorini) with prescribed durations:
  • Prague: 4 days
  • Reykjavik: 4 days (and the wedding must be attended on one of the days between day 4 and day 7—here, being in Reykjavik from Day 4 to 7 lets you attend on Day 4 or later)
  • Munich: 4 days (so that one of its days falls between day 7 and day 10 for your friend meet‐up)
  • Porto: 5 days
  • Amsterdam: 2 days (which exactly cover the conference on day 14 and day 15)
  • Santorini: 2 days
– Because flights occur on the same day that counts into both segments, the schedule is designed with overlaps.
– The chosen flight legs (with direct flight connections as given) are:
  Prague → Reykjavik (direct, as “Prague and Reykjavik” is allowed),
  Reykjavik → Munich (“Reykjavik and Munich”),
  Munich → Porto (“Munich and Porto”),
  Porto → Amsterdam (“Porto and Amsterdam”),
  Amsterdam → Santorini (“Amsterdam and Santorini”).
– Calculating the day ranges:
  • Prague: Day 1–4 (4 days)
  • Reykjavik: starts on Day 4 (overlap with Prague) and goes through Day 7 (4 days; wedding can be attended on Day 4, 5, 6, or 7)
  • Munich: starts on Day 7 (overlap with Reykjavik) and goes through Day 10 (4 days; meeting your friend during this time is possible)
  • Porto: starts on Day 10 and runs through Day 14 (5 days)
  • Amsterdam: starts on Day 14 and runs through Day 15 (2 days; meeting your conference requirement)
  • Santorini: starts on Day 15 and ends on Day 16 (2 days)
– Total days = 4 + 4 + 4 + 5 + 2 + 2 – 5 (overlap days) = 16 days.
This itinerary meets all city‐visit durations, event time windows, and the direct flight conditions. */
